claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of this package recovers P in G1 with e(P,Q) = z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P = infinity for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh algorithm coins. Modelled success 0.3939, every probabilistic premise either a proven bound or a charged cost ([6a] prints the labeled product): success = (1 - 2^-190) x (1 - P(abort)) with the Wiedemann projections bound N/r < 2^-190 (verified on dropped rows, retried with fresh projections) and Markov P(abort) <= 1.5E'/cap at the charged cap. E' = 2^119.2726 is the boot-restart-inclusive expectation: the boot's all-16-fail event draws a fresh certified lattice and is charged as a geometric restart inside E', not a failure mode (independence affects only that cost term; the total-dependence worst case 2^120.478 < cap is a printed sensitivity row). The model E structurally upper-bounds the adaptively encountered descent (bin-worst child charging; one-sided yield components — note section 6.0b) and the 1.5x allowance prices the residual model error. Under the disclosed NFS heuristics (H3's discriminant half verified exactly by integer-identity resultant certificates; the class-number half the standard disclosed hypothesis). A global meter bounds all classical work, including preprocessing, failures, transfers, storage, verification and output, by W <= 2^122.65 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; the ledger totals 2^122.6255 and the deterministic in-sandbox recompute reproduces it exactly (delta 0.0000): relation collection 2^121.9501 (B = 2^69, the descent plan's native factor base; the native region trimmed by the calibrated s* = 2^-0.00011987 = 0.999917 to the plan's LOG2_RELS exactly, margin 0.3322; per-cell 461.28 with the certified evaluator at C_NB_EVAL = 4,000 from a measured 3,974.3 Ir/evaluation, bit-identical survivor sets on all 2,401 pool rows), linear algebra 2^119.7003 (N = 2^59.5871 = pad 1.4 x N/U 0.049049 x U = 2^63.4513, the B = 2^69 factor base's columns; LA = 3N x 100 x 96 / C = 2 log2 N + 0.526), descent cap 2^120.58 (E' = 2^119.2726 at SLACK = 80, retention min 0.8591, inflated loss 1.85e-4, UDUP = 0.35 at 1.9x below the 3-sigma lower bound 0.667 of twelve production-geometry re-measurements over the full 840-unit set); the cap is the smallest value on the declared 0.01-bit grid above the exact threshold log2(1.5E'/0.61) = 120.5707; remaining components <= 2^90.33 (exact sum 2^90.3231). Storage follows the reference per-object bounded layout with priced transfers and block-segmented addressing (no object exceeds 2^61 bytes; peak total <= 2^105 bytes, stated numerically in the note); nothing is amortised over future targets.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes in-sandbox the tower and H3 certificates and toy unit ranks, the pool, the measurement parse, the relation-collection ledger at the plan-native B = 2^69 (corrected dilation law; the shipped calibration s* = 2^-0.00011987 verified and bracketed, margin 0.3322), the linear-algebra charge at the matching U = 2^63.4513 with a live filtsim spot-check, the exact bad-prime retention laws with live allowance and UDUP spots, the three-row live descent E ladder (boot restart charged: E' = 2^119.2726; shipped calibration 120.466 reproduced), the cap on the declared 0.01-bit grid above the exact threshold 120.5707, the restructured success chain (boot as charged cost, dependence worst case as a sensitivity row), and prints the total ledger 2^122.6255 with per-section PASS markers and a final JSON ledger line; the output is self-contained and its quoted_offline list states the evidence split.
